name: Cool (reflective) roof
cooling_evidence: London model: about -1.2 C average 2 m air temperature (up to about -2 C in some locations) on 2 hot days in summer 2018. Vienna model: about -0.25 C (roof albedo up to 0.45) to -0.5 C (up to 0.7) mean summer temperature in dense areas.
source: Brousse et al. 2024, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1029/2024GL109634; Zuvela-Aloise et al. 2018, Theoretical and Applied Climatology, doi:10.1007/s00704-016-2024-2

name: Street trees
cooling_evidence: Review of 202 studies: average air cooling of 3.8 C (+/- 3.1), so very variable. London city-scale model: only about -0.3 C on average for street-level vegetation. Local effects are much larger than city-wide effects.
source: Kumar et al. 2024, The Innovation, doi:10.1016/j.xinn.2024.100588; Brousse et al. 2024, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1029/2024GL109634

name: Green wall
cooling_evidence: Review of 202 studies: average air cooling of 4.1 C (+/- 4.2), very variable across studies.
source: Kumar et al. 2024, The Innovation, doi:10.1016/j.xinn.2024.100588

name: Green roof
cooling_evidence: London model: about 0 C on average city-wide, but a daytime cooling effect. Vienna model: heat load reduction of similar size to high-reflectivity roofs, but only about 45% of roof area is suitable and the potential is mostly in industrial areas on the outskirts.
source: Brousse et al. 2024, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1029/2024GL109634; Zuvela-Aloise et al. 2018, Theoretical and Applied Climatology, doi:10.1007/s00704-016-2024-2

name: Reflective pavement
cooling_evidence: Multi-criteria scoring study (literature and expert judgement, not measured temperatures): reflective pavements 2.45 vs street trees 3.50 overall, but better on thermal comfort and applicability. Separate Los Angeles simulation: cool pavements reduced air temperature but raised pedestrian heat stress (PET +2.2 C) in unshaded spots, and lowered it (PET -1.1 C) near existing trees.
source: Janusaite and Mikucioniene 2026, Mokslas - Lietuvos ateitis, doi:10.3846/mla.2026.27186; Taleghani, Sailor and Ban-Weiss 2016, Environmental Research Letters, https://pdxscholar.library.pdx.edu/mengin_fac/91

name: Unsealing paved surfaces
cooling_evidence: Tested as a scenario (reduction of paved surfaces) in Vienna NbS modelling, alongside higher albedo, green roofs, new parks and a combination; no figures used here.
source: Zuvela-Aloise, Hahn, Buegelmayer-Blaschek and Schneider, EMS Annual Meeting 2023, doi:10.5194/ems2023-316

name: Pocket park
cooling_evidence: Parks are among the well-studied green infrastructure types in the review. The average park effect has not been checked against the full paper, so no figure is shown here.
source: Kumar et al. 2024, The Innovation, doi:10.1016/j.xinn.2024.100588

name: Green corridor
cooling_evidence: No dedicated evidence found; rationale is extending the cooling of parks and river corridors.
